items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $500,000 in UPS, Altria and Omega Healthcare Collects $2,448 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA 67-year-old with $500,000 split evenly across UPS, Altria and Omega Healthcare Investors collects about $29,400 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $2,450 a month. Altria’s dividend took 78% of free cash flow over the trailing-12 months, and the company targets mid-single-digit dividend growth each year through 2028.
